reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Honey Luminous Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: This is a pretty good mask. Not stellar but it’s good when your skin is tired and needs a little boost. I usually cut the mask to fit my face better. The formula is a little heavy and sticky if you don’t use moisturizer after.
reviews.zh: 呢款面膜幾好用。唔算頂級，但係皮膚攰、想輕輕 boost 一下嘅時候就好啱。我通常會剪開面膜貼合面型。如果之後唔搽保濕霜，質地會有少少厚重同黏笠。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Honey Luminous Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: Very nice mask, it is moisturizing and did not break me out. My skin is acne prone and most product break me out, but this mask didn't.
reviews.zh: 非常好用嘅面膜，保濕得，而且冇令我爆瘡。我嘅皮膚容易爆瘡，大部分產品都會令我爆瘡，但係呢款面膜冇。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Honey Luminous Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: Planning to try to see if it’s more effective than the ones I’m using now on my skin
reviews.zh: 打算試吓睇吓係咪比我而家用緊嘅更有效

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Honey Luminous Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: Not sure about it but i only used it once so i am not too sure about it
reviews.zh: 唔太清楚，因為我淨係用過一次，所以都唔太確定

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Honey Luminous Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: A wonderful face mask; after a few minutes it can be removed, leaving the skin super radiant and soft
reviews.zh: 一款好好用嘅面膜；敷幾分鐘之後就可以撕走，皮膚變得好有光澤又柔軟

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Honey Luminous Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: I like honey products, its soooo natural, and nourishing, i like my skin after using it, i leave it for long time
reviews.zh: 我鍾意蜂蜜產品，佢超級天然、滋潤，用完之後我好鍾意自己嘅皮膚，我會敷好耐

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Honey Luminous Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: Недорогая маска среднего качества, скорее питательная чем увлажняющая. За ее цену неплохо. Пользуюсь кремом из той же серии .
reviews.zh: 平價中等品質嘅面膜，比較偏向滋養多過保濕。以佢嘅價錢嚟算係唔錯。我有用同一系列嘅面霜。
